title: The Briefing
subtitle: Project Titan Kickoff & Project Amigo Scope Planning
description: You've just joined Titan Manufacturing as a Digital Transformation Consultant on behalf of Brained. The executive kickoff call for Project Amigo with ICICI Bank's 80,000 employees begins now. Orient yourself, navigate high-stakes executive tension between Marcus Reed (CTO) and Sophia Bennett (ICICI Client Lead), document the official record in ReadMe AI, and complete Aarav Kapoor's initial scope-planning assignment.

stakeholders.name: Marcus Reed
stakeholders.agenda: Architectural integrity, technical feasibility, avoiding unvetted delivery promises.

stakeholders.name: Sophia Bennett
stakeholders.role: Head of HR Operations · ICICI Bank
stakeholders.agenda: Deliver all 12 HRMS modules strictly before the 90-day nationwide appraisal window.

stakeholders.name: Daniel Brooks
stakeholders.agenda: Managing infrastructure bottlenecks, resolving LDAP credentials access for Single Sign-On.

stakeholders.name: Aarav Kapoor
stakeholders.agenda: Senior governance, accurate MoM capture, structured scope prioritization.

objectives.label: Attend the Project Amigo Kickoff Call with camera engagement
Respond to Sophia's 90-day deadline demand under CTO scrutiny
Review and correct AI-generated minutes in ReadMe AI
Prioritize high-impact modules in Project Amigo Initial Scope Planning
Formulate LDAP sandbox dependency strategy without stalling the engagement
Establish mandatory architectural validation gates before sprint commencement

deliverables: Project Amigo Kickoff Minutes of Meeting (MoM)
Project Amigo Initial Scope Planning & Assignment 01 Submission
